articles.summary: Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.52 per common share. The dividend will be payable in cash on October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on September 30, 2026. About Ventas Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) is an SP 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With approximately 1,450 properties in North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas occupies an essential role in the longevity economy. The Company’s growth is fueled by its more than 900 senior housing communities, which provide valuable services to residents and enable them to thrive in supported environments. Ventas aims to deliver outsized performance by leveraging its operational expertise, data-driven insights from its Ventas OI TM platform, extensive relationships and strong financial position.
